scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Welcome to the Training Grounds.
You are now in the outer court yard. Please go inside the castle to begin your training.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
歡迎來到訓練場。
您現在位於外庭院，請進入城堡開始您的訓練。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Come in!
I would like
to welcome you to
the Training Grounds!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
請進！
歡迎您來到訓練場！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
Go, Novice, go!
Fight, and grow stronger! Look towards a brighter tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
去吧，初心者，去吧！
戰鬥，變得更強！向著更美好的明天前進！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Guard]
In here, you can prepare
yourself for your future
adventures throughout the
Ragnarok world!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場衛兵]
在這裡，您可以為未來在仙境傳說世界中的冒險做好準備！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Hello, you look to be new here.
What is your name?
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
您好，您看起來是新來的。
請問您叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Sorry, but I don't think I heard
you correctly
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
抱歉，我想我可能沒有聽清楚。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Welcome!
You are at the entrance
of the ^3355FFTraining Grounds^000000.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
歡迎光臨！
您現在位於^3355FF訓練場^000000的入口處。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
If you're new
to the Ragnarok world,
please choose the
^3355FFTraining Grounds Introduction^000000
menu for more information.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
如果您是仙境傳說世界的新人，請選擇^3355FF訓練場介紹^000000選單以獲取更多資訊。

scripts.text: Apply for training.
scripts.translation: 申請訓練

scripts.text: Direct access to Ragnarok Online.
scripts.translation: 直接進入仙境傳說

scripts.text: ^3355FFTraining Grounds Introduction.^000000
I need a moment to think.
scripts.translation: 我需要考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Thank you for applying for Novice training. For detailed information of each training course, please inquire the Guides for assistance.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
感謝您申請初心者訓練。如需瞭解各訓練課程的詳細資訊，請諮詢嚮導。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
When you have questions about the training course process, please feel free to ask any of the Tutors.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
如果您對訓練課程流程有任何疑問，請隨時嚮導師諮詢。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
You will now be transferred
to the Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
您現在將被傳送到訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
I understand.
Please do your
best, and I wish you
the best of luck!
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
我明白了。
請加油，祝您一切順利！

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
This training grounds was established in order to provide useful information to new players of Ragnarok Online by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom's Board of Education.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
本訓練場由盧恩·米德加茲王國教育部設立，旨在為仙境傳說的新玩家提供有用的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
The training course is organized into two parts: the Basic Knowledge classes, and Field Combat training.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
訓練課程分為兩部分：基礎知識課程和野外戰鬥訓練。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Through the first course, players will learn the necessary knowledge for a smoother gaming experience.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
通過第一門課程，玩家將學習到有助於更順暢遊戲體驗的必要知識。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
In Field Combat Training,
players will engage in actual battle with weak monsters so they can learn the basics of fighting.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
在野外戰鬥訓練中，玩家將與弱小的魔物進行實戰，以學習戰鬥的基礎知識。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
With this battle practice,
players will be able to gain more experience before they enter the real world.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
通過這種實戰練習，玩家可以在進入真實世界之前獲得更多的經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
At the end of the training, we will provide an introduction to the 1st Job Classes. This will help players decide which job class is best for them.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
訓練結束後，我們將介紹一轉職業。
這將幫助玩家決定哪個職業最適合自己。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
If you wish to participate in the training grounds, please choose '^3355FFApply for training^000000' in the menu.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
如果您想參加訓練場，請在選單中選擇'^3355FF申請訓練^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
Otherwise, if you want to skip the basic training and immediately enter the world of Ragnarok Online, please choose '^3355FFDirect access to Ragnarok Online^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
否則，如果您想跳過基礎訓練並直接進入仙境傳說，請選擇'^3355FF直接進入仙境傳說^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Training Grounds Receptionist]
I understand.
Please, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[訓練場接待員]
我明白了。
請慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Hm...?
What are you
still doing here?
Oh, you used a ^3355FFButterfly Wing^000000, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
嗯...？
你怎麼還在這裡？
哦，你用了^3355FF蝴蝶翅膀^000000，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
No, no, no~
You're supposed to use the Butterfly Wing when you want to go back to a town ^666666after^000000 completing your training here, alright?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
不，不，不~
你應該在^666666完成^000000這裡的訓練後，想要回到城鎮時才使用蝴蝶翅膀，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Now, let me send
you back to the
Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
現在，讓我送你回訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
The Training Grounds
are located just past
the bridge located
to the right.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
訓練場就在右邊那座橋的另一邊。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Although you'll
be sitting through
some classes, you
won't regret it.
Now, go for it!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
雖然你要上幾節課，但你不會後悔的。
現在，去吧！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Hey...
You little rascal!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
嘿...
你這小搗蛋鬼！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Wait...
Calm down Shion.
You're a professional
trainer! Don't get all
upset at a Novice!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
等等...
冷靜點，紫苑。
你是專業的訓練師！別對一個初心者發火！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Go and cross the bridge to the right, right now! ^666666*Ahem*^000000 You'll see and castle, and inside you can meet all sorts of tutors.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
現在就去右邊的橋那邊！^666666*咳*^000000 你會看到一座城堡，裡面可以見到各種各樣的導師。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
If you can't see the entrance, just change your in-game camera angle by holding down the ^3355FFright Mouse button^000000 and dragging your mouse. Easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
如果你看不到入口，只需按住^3355FF滑鼠右鍵^000000並拖動滑鼠來改變遊戲內的攝像機角度。很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
To reset your camera angle,
just double-click the right Mouse button. Okay then, take care!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
要重置攝像機角度，只需雙擊滑鼠右鍵。好了，保重！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Oh, and before you leave,
learn how to treat a lady nice, okay? Then they might give you gifts like this!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
哦，在你離開之前，學會如何善待女士，好嗎？那樣她們可能會給你這樣的禮物！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Huh...?
Why are you
still here?
^666666*Sigh...*^000000

[Shion]
Hey, when you enter the Training Grounds, you'll learn all sorts of things that will help you play the game. You'll even have the chance to get zeny and other rewards.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
嘿，當你進入訓練場時，你會學到各種有助於玩遊戲的東西。你甚至有機會獲得Zeny和其他獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
You can even gain
experience like this!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你甚至可以像這樣獲得經驗值！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Everything you'll learn here in the Training Grounds will benefit your gameplay. So just think positive, okay?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你在訓練場學到的一切都會對你的遊戲有幫助。所以保持積極的心態，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Hello there~
Welcome to the
Training Grounds!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你好呀~
歡迎來到訓練場！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Let's see.
Your name is...
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
讓我看看。
你的名字是...
{0}。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
My name is Shion.
Yes, this is the first time we've met, of course. Hahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
我叫紫苑。
沒錯，這是我們第一次見面，當然啦。哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Now that we've met, is there anything I can help you with?
I'm here for your questions~
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
既然我們見面了，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？
我在這裡就是為了回答你的問題~

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我該去哪裡？

scripts.text: About Basic Interfaces.
scripts.translation: 關於基礎介面

scripts.text: Who the crap are you?
scripts.translation: 你他媽是誰？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Do you see the bridge to your
right side? Just cross the bridge and you'll arrive at a castle. All you have to do is walk inside!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你看到右邊的橋了嗎？
只需走過那座橋，你就會到達一座城堡。
你只需要走進去就行了！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
The entrance of the castle
is a ^4D4DFFspinning white light^000000. These portals are what allow you to move from one zone to another.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
城堡的入口是一個^4D4DFF旋轉的白色光柱^000000。
這些傳送門可以讓你從一個區域移動到另一個區域。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Do you know how to move?
Left click on a spot, and you'll walk over to that spot. Piece of cake, huh?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
你知道怎麼移動嗎？
左鍵點選一個位置，你就會走到那個位置。小菜一碟，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
So go for it!
Basically, you must enter the castle in order to start your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
那就去吧！
基本上，你必須進入城堡才能開始你的冒險。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
There are soldiers
at the entrance, so don't
worry about getting lost.
Take care now~!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
入口處有士兵，所以不用擔心迷路。
再見啦~！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Basic Interfaces...
Do you know what Click, Double-click and Drag mean?
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
基礎介面...
你知道點選、雙擊和拖拽是什麼意思嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shion]
When you press the
left Mouse button once,
that is a click. When you press the mouse button twice in a row, that's a double-click.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
當你按一次滑鼠左鍵時，那就是點選。當你連續按兩次滑鼠按鍵時，那就是雙擊。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Dragging is when you move your Mouse while holding down the
Mouse button after clicking on something.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
拖拽是指你在點選某物後，按住滑鼠按鍵的同時移動滑鼠。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Before we start talking about
the Basic Interfaces, you should remember these terms, just because we'll be using them frequently.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
在我們開始討論基礎介面前，你應該記住這些術語，因為我們會經常用到它們。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Inside the castle, there is a Basic Interfaces Tutor who can teach you the basics more clearly, okay? Enter the castle to start your training.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
城堡裡有一位基礎介面導師，他可以更清楚地教你基礎知識，好嗎？進入城堡開始你的訓練吧。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
The entrance
of the castle is
a ^4D4DFFspinning white light^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
城堡的入口是一個^4D4DFF旋轉的白色光柱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shion]
There are soldiers
at the entrance, so don't
worry about getting lost.
Take care now~!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
入口處有士兵，所以不用擔心迷路。
再見啦~！

scripts.text:
[Shion]
Me? I'm Shion!
But that's a rude way of asking! I'm volunteering my time and effort here, so you've got to show me a little bit of respect at least!
scripts.translation:
[紫苑]
我？我是紫苑！
不過你這麼問也太沒禮貌了！我在這裡是自願付出時間和精力的，所以至少要對我表現出一點尊重！

scripts.text:
[Kris]
You've completed all the essential courses. Have you spoken to the assistant tutors already? The field combat training will be your next course. Would you like to proceed?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你已經完成了所有基礎課程。你之前和助教們交談過了嗎？下一門課程是野外戰鬥訓練。你想繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: No, I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 不，我稍後再來

scripts.text: Send me to a town!
scripts.translation: 送我回城鎮！

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Your next course is Field Combat training. Please listen carefully to your next trainer, and I hope you pass the course. Godspeed.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你的下一門課程是野外戰鬥訓練。請認真聽下一位導師的講解，祝你順利通過考試。加油。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Alright then. In the meantime, you might want to speak to the assistant tutors, as the basic information taught in the essential courses may not be enough for new adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
好的。在此期間，建議你多和助教們交流，因為基礎課程中教授的資訊對於新冒險者來說可能還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Feel free to come back any time when you need my assistance.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
如果你需要幫助，隨時歡迎回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
So, would you like to be sent to a town? If you're confident that you've learned enough, head over to the right and speak to the ^3355FFKafra Employee^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
那麼，你想被傳送到城鎮嗎？如果你確信自己已經學得足夠多了，請往右邊走，去和^3355FF卡普拉 職員^000000交談。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
The Kafra Services are very convenient once you get out into the real world. Their Teleport Service can be used to travel from town to town, and you can keep your items safe in the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
當你進入真實世界後，卡普拉服務會非常方便。你可以使用瞬間移動服務在城鎮之間旅行，也可以將物品安全地存放在卡普拉倉庫中。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
We may never meet again, but I hope you grow stronger and become a great adventurer. Godspeed.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
我們可能不會再見面了，但我希望你能變得更強，成為一名偉大的冒險者。加油。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Hello, may I see your
proof of registration?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你好，請出示你的註冊證明。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Ah, {0}, you've applied for an old training course that we no longer provide for our trainees. Let me issue a new proof of registration for you.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
啊，{0}，你申請的是我們不再為學員提供的舊版培訓課程。讓我為你簽發一份新的註冊證明。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Okay, now
you're ready to go.
In my class, I teach the
use of the most basic
interfaces.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
好了，現在你準備好出發了。在我的課上，我教的是最基礎的介面操作。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
{0}.
would you like to learn
more about interface
fundamentals?
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
{0}，你想了解更多關於介面基礎知識的內容嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Nah, I'm a pro~
scripts.translation: 不用了，我是高手~

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kris]
First, it's possible to move every interface window on your screen by dragging the window. Just click on the window, hold down the mouse button and move your mouse.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
首先，你可以通過拖動來移動螢幕上的任何介面視窗。只需點選視窗，按住滑鼠按鈕並移動滑鼠即可。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Now, let me explain each interface window according to their default positions on your screen.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
現在，讓我根據它們在螢幕上的預設位置，逐一解釋每個介面視窗。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
At the upper left side of your screen, you will see a window with your character name and level. This is the ^3355FFBasic Information Window^000000.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在螢幕的左上角，你會看到一個顯示角色名稱和等級的視窗。這是^3355FF基本資訊視窗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Let me give you
some experience points.
Keep an eye on your Basic Info Window and observe the change in your Base Level experience gauge.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
讓我給你一些經驗值。請留意你的基本資訊視窗，觀察基礎等級經驗值條的變化。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
But...
I guess you're already familiar with the Base Level experience gauge.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
不過...我想你已經熟悉基礎等級經驗值條了。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Did you see...?
As you gain experience,
the experience gauge fills up.
Once it is 100 % full, you gain an experience level, and the gauge is reset to 0.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
你看到了嗎？隨著你獲得經驗值，經驗值條會逐漸填滿。當它達到100%時，你會提升一個經驗等級，然後經驗值條會重置為0。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
At the bottom of the Basic Info Window, you will see two different experience gauge bars. The top bar is for your current Base Level, and the bottom one displays experience for your current Job Level.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在基本資訊視窗的底部，你會看到兩個不同的經驗值條。上面的條顯示當前基礎等級的經驗值，下面的條顯示當前職業等級的經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
When the Job Level
Experience bar is filled, you will earn a Job Level, and a ^3355FFSkill Point^000000. Skill Points are spent to learn skills for your character.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
當職業等級經驗值條填滿時，你將提升一個職業等級，並獲得一個^3355FF技能點^000000。技能點用於學習角色的技能。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
On the right side
of the Basic Info window,
you will see various
Menu buttons.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在基本資訊視窗的右側，你會看到各種選單按鈕。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Clicking these Menu buttons will open other Interface Windows, such as the Inventory Window
or Party Window.
scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
點選這些選單按鈕會開啟其他介面視窗，例如物品欄視窗或隊伍視窗。

scripts.text:
[Kris]
Now...

scripts.translation:
[克里斯]
在聊天視窗的右下角，你應該能看到兩個藍色按鈕。左邊的按鈕用於更改你的聊天選項。

[Kris]

everyone on your screen.

[克里斯]

[Kris]

scripts.translation:
[克里斯]

[Kris]

[Kris]

[克里斯]

謝謝，讓我送您去野外戰鬥訓練課程。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let me introduce you
to the Kafra Services.
In the menu, please choose
the service you'd like to
learn more about.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
讓我向您介紹一下卡普拉服務。
請在選單中選擇您想要了解更多詳情的服務。

scripts.text: Save service
scripts.translation: 存檔服務

scripts.text: Storage service
scripts.translation: 倉庫服務

scripts.translation: 瞬間移動服務

scripts.translation: 手推車租賃服務

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
When you talk to a Kafra Employee and ask for the Save Service, the location of where you will revive, after being defeated in battle, will be changed.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
當您與卡普拉 職員交談並要求使用存檔服務時，您在戰鬥中戰敗後復活的地點將會被更改。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point is always the last place where you have saved. Using a Butterfly Wing will return you to the place where you
last saved.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您的復活點始終是您最後一次存檔的地點。使用蝴蝶翅膀將返回您最後一次存檔的地點。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employoee]
The Save Service
is also provided by
the Kafra Corporation
free of charge~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
存檔服務也是由卡普拉公司免費提供的哦~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation is the world's largest company with a long and distinguished history on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
卡普拉公司是米德加爾特大陸上歷史悠久、聲名顯赫的世界最大企業。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can store and retrieve
your items in any town at your convenience. This Storage is shared by every character on one account.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
您可以在任何城鎮方便地存取您的物品。這個倉庫由同一賬號下的所有角色共享。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
It's unreasonable to carry all of your items with you when you don't need them right away. Please use our Storage and keep your items safe and secure.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
當不需要立即使用所有物品時，隨身攜帶它們是不合理的。請使用我們的倉庫，讓您的物品安全存放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Our convenient Storage Service
is provided to our customers for a small fee which is different from town to town.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
我們方便實用的倉庫服務向顧客收取少量費用，具體費用因城鎮而異。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
However, you must be
at least ^3355FFBasic Skill Level 6^000000
to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
但是，您必須至少達到^3355FF基本技能等級 6^000000才能使用倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are 3 different item sections of the Storage into which items are organized: Consumable, Equipment and Etc.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
倉庫中有3個不同的物品分類，物品按以下類別整理：消耗品、裝備和其他。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
There are a maximum of 300 Inventory Slots in Kafra Storage, meaning you can have up to 300 different kinds of items in Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
卡普拉倉庫最多有300個物品欄位，意味著您可以在倉庫中存放多達300種不同的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Remember though, that in the case of Equipment, each item takes up one Inventory Slot. The maximum number of items that can be placed in Kafra Storage is 30,000.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
請記住，對於裝備而言，每件物品佔用一個物品欄位。可以放置在卡普拉倉庫中的物品總數上限為30,000件。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation
provides our valued customers with a convenient Teleport Service which greatly cuts down on your
traveling time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
卡普拉公司為我們尊貴的顧客提供便捷的瞬間移動服務，大大減少了您的旅行時間。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Our Teleport Service is safe and comfortable, and will allow you to fully explore the various lands of the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
我們的瞬間移動服務安全舒適，讓您能夠充分探索米德加爾特大陸的各個地區。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We thank our valued customers for their great support and continue to provide them with the best
of service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
感謝我們尊貴的顧客的大力支援，我們將繼續為您提供最優質的服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation
provides a Cart Rental Service to Merchants, as well as Blacksmiths and Alchemists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
卡普拉公司為商人、鐵匠和鍊金術士提供手推車租賃服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The flamboyantly mysterious
^CE6300Super Novice^000000 can use Carts, but we officially don't have a contract with that class. Still, somehow...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
華麗而神秘的^CE6300超級初心者^000000也可以使用手推車，但我們官方並沒有與該職業簽訂合同。不過，不知為何...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Anyway, Merchants, Blacksmiths and Alchemists must also learn the ^3355FFPush Cart^000000 skill in order to be able to rent a cart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
總之，商人、鐵匠和鍊金術士也必須學習^3355FF手推車^000000技能，才能租賃手推車。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Cart Rental service
charge will differ from
town to town.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
手推車租賃服務的費用因城鎮而異。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
謝謝。

scripts.text:

Welcome to my class.
Choose the subject you
wish to learn more about.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
歡迎來到我的課堂。
請選擇您想深入瞭解的主題。

scripts.translation: 基本資訊視窗

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Let's take a look at
the Basic Info Window,
shall we?
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
我們要不來看看基本資訊視窗？

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Your name, job, Basic Level,
and your Job Level are displayed in this window. ^800FFFBase level^000000 is your character's level.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您的名字、職業、基礎等級和職業等級都顯示在這個視窗中。^800FFF基礎等級^000000是您角色的等級。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The ^800fffJob Level^000000 shown under the
Base Level displays the Job level of your character. When you just start a job, you will be at
Job Level 1.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
顯示在基礎等級下方的^800fff職業等級^000000是您角色的職業等級。
當您剛開始一個職業時，您的職業等級為1。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Basic Info window, your current experience points are displayed in the Base Level experience bar.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
在基本資訊視窗中，您當前的經驗值顯示在基礎等級經驗條中。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Experience points in Ragnarok Online are indicated by percentage. Base and Job experience are separate from each other.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
仙境傳說中的經驗值以百分比表示。基礎經驗和職業經驗是相互獨立的。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
When the Base Level or
Job Level bar reaches 100 it will be raised by one level and the bar will then reset to 0 for the next level.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
當基礎等級或職業等級條達到100時，等級將提升一級，然後條會重置為0，以便進入下一級。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
HP stands for 'health points.'
When your HP is reduced to 0, you will faint and be unable to fight. You can either return to your spawn point, or wait for someone to revive you.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
HP代表“生命值”。
當您的HP降至0時，您將昏迷並無法戰鬥。您可以返回出生點，或者等待他人復活您。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you die in the fields or dungeons, you will receive
a ^FF0000-1 % EXP penalty^000000, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
如果您在野外或地下城中死亡，將會受到^FF0000-1% 經驗值懲罰^000000，所以請小心。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
SP stands for 'spell points.'
When you become a 1st class, you will learn unique class skills of the class that will require SP to use. Your skill instructor can teach you more about skills.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
SP代表“魔法值”。
當您轉職為一轉職業時，您將學習該職業獨有的技能，使用這些技能需要消耗SP。您的技能導師可以向您介紹更多關於技能的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you want to check the weight limit of the items you can carry, check the bottom left of the
Basic Info window.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
如果您想檢視可攜帶物品的重量上限，請檢視基本資訊視窗的左下角。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The current weight of the items you are carrying will be displayed next to your maximum weight limit.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您當前攜帶物品的重量將顯示在最大重量上限旁邊。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you carry over 50 % of your maximum weight limit, your HP and SP will not be restored by resting, so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
如果您攜帶的物品重量超過最大重量上限的50%，休息時將無法恢復HP和SP，所以請小心。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The numerical value next to the weight limit shows the current amount of Zeny, the currency of Midgard, that you possess.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
重量上限旁邊的數值顯示您當前擁有的Zeny數量，Zeny是米德加爾特大陸的貨幣。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
On the right side of the
Basic Info Window is a series of buttons that will open other interface windows. Click them one by one, and check what you can do with them.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
在基本資訊視窗的右側有一系列按鈕，點選它們可以開啟其他介面視窗。請逐一點選，看看它們的功能。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The shortcut for minimizing and maximizing the Basic Info Window
is '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFV^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
最小化和最大化基本資訊視窗的快捷鍵是'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFV^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can open the Party Window
by clicking the ^3355FFfriend^000000 button in the Basic Info window. The shortcut for the Party Window is '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFZ^000000.' You can use this window to check on the members of your party.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您可以點選基本資訊視窗中的^3355FF好友^000000按鈕來開啟隊伍視窗。隊伍視窗的快捷鍵是'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFZ^000000'。您可以使用此視窗檢視隊伍成員的狀態。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The Party master can determine
the distribution of EXP and items to the party. You can also check the location of your party members on the Mini-Map.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
隊長可以決定隊伍中經驗值和物品的分配方式。您也可以在小地圖上檢視隊伍成員的位置。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Party Window, you can click on the ^3355FFFriend^000000 button to see your Friend List. You can use the
Friend List to send whispers
to your friends.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
在隊伍視窗中，您可以點選^3355FF好友^000000按鈕檢視好友列表。您可以使用好友列表向您的朋友傳送悄悄話。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can ask your skill instructor to learn more about organizing parties. But I guess you can also just try that on your own.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您可以向您的技能導師請教更多關於組建隊伍的知識。不過，我想您也可以自己嘗試一下。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The item window is divided into
3 sections: consumable items, equipment and other items.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
物品視窗分為3個部分：消耗品、裝備和其他物品。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Your weight limit does limit the amount of items you can carry with you. When you're carrying too many things, place your extra stuff in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您的重量上限限制了您可以攜帶的物品數量。當您攜帶的物品過多時，請將多餘的東西存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Also, equipment and consumable items can also be assigned to a Hotkey through the Hotkey bar.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
此外，裝備和消耗品也可以通過快捷欄分配快捷鍵。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The Hotkey window is opened by pressing ^3355FFF12^000000 key. The F1 to F9 keys are the designated hotkeys.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
按下^3355FFF12^000000鍵可以開啟快捷欄視窗。F1到F9鍵是指定的快捷鍵。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
There are total of 3 sets
of Hotkeys. You can toggle
between Hotkey sets by
pressing the F12 button.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
總共有3組快捷鍵。您可以按F12鍵在不同的快捷鍵組之間切換。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can open the Option Window
by pressing the ^3355FFoption^000000 button in the Basic Info window. You can also press the '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFO^000000' keys as well.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您可以按下基本資訊視窗中的^3355FF選項^000000按鈕來開啟選項視窗。您也可以按'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFO^000000'鍵。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Option Window, you can adjust sound, GUI skin, and the transparency of the skin.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
在選項視窗中，您可以調整聲音、介面皮膚以及皮膚的透明度。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
With the sound button, you can turn the background music on or off, as well as adjust the volume. The same can be done for the sound effects.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
通過聲音按鈕，您可以開啟或關閉背景音樂，並調整音量。音效也可以進行相同的設定。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
With the Skin option, you can change the GUI skin for the in-game windows. Scroll through the list of the skins you have and choose
a skin.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
通過“皮膚”選項，您可以更改遊戲內視窗的介面皮膚。請在您擁有的皮膚列表中滾動瀏覽，並選擇一款皮膚。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can also download official skins from our official website:
^0000FFhttp://iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您還可以從我們的官方網站下載官方皮膚：
^0000FFhttp://iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
The Snap option allows your mouse cursor to automatically be placed on a target once it hovers within the target's vicinity.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
“自動吸附”選項可以讓您的滑鼠游標在懸停於目標附近時自動鎖定該目標。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
When you click to attack, your mouse cursor will automatically change into a sword shape. Skill and item targeting also work with the Snap function.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
當您點選攻擊時，滑鼠游標會自動變成劍的形狀。技能和物品的目標鎖定也支援“自動吸附”功能。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
It might be useful or awkward if you're not used to it. But once you're familiar with the Snap function, you will be able to adjust your own snap options.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
如果您不習慣，它可能很好用，也可能讓您覺得彆扭。但一旦您熟悉了“自動吸附”功能，就可以自行調整相關選項了。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Well, it all depends on your experience. That's all for the Option Window.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
好吧，這完全取決於您的使用習慣。以上就是選項視窗的全部內容了。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
Click the ^3355FFequip^000000 button
in your Basic Info Window,
or just press the '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFQ^000000' keys.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
點選基本資訊視窗中的^3355FF裝備^000000按鈕，或者直接按'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFQ^000000'鍵。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
In the Equipment Window,
you will see the items currently equipped on your character. In the very beginning, every character is equipped with a Knife and
a Cotton Shirt.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
在裝備視窗中，您可以看到角色當前裝備的物品。在遊戲初期，每個角色都裝備有一把小刀和一件棉襯衫。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
There are 2 ways to change your equipment. Double-click equipment in the Inventory Window or click and drag an item into the
Equipment Window.
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
更改裝備有兩種方式：在物品欄視窗中雙擊裝備，或者將物品拖拽到裝備視窗中。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
You can also assign equipment to Hotkeys. This can be down when you drag equipment from the Inventory into the Hotkey Window.
('^3355FFF12^000000' key).
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
您還可以將裝備分配給快捷鍵。只需將裝備從物品欄拖拽到快捷鍵視窗即可（'^3355FFF12^000000'鍵）。

scripts.text:
[Edwin]
If you have
any questions,
feel free to ask me~
scripts.translation:
[埃德溫]
如果您有任何問題，請隨時問我~

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Welcome, new adventurer.
I, Jare Riotte will help you to learn about the fundamental
rules of your Character Statuses.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
歡迎，新的冒險者。
我是亞雷·里奧特，我將幫助您瞭解角色狀態的基礎規則。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Also known as 'Stats,'
your statuses are the fundamental building blocks of your character.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
您的狀態也被稱為“屬性”，是構成角色的基礎要素。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
I am willing to help you learn about the statuses more than anything else, so feel free to ask me about character statuses you
may be wondering about.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
比起其他事情，我更願意幫助您瞭解狀態，所以如果您有任何關於角色狀態的疑問，請隨時問我。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
In Ragnarok Online,
the Character Statuses are Strength, Agility, Vitality, Intelligence, Dexterity and Luck.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
在《仙境傳說》中，角色狀態包括力量、敏捷、體質、智力、靈巧和幸運。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
I want my class to proceed
according to your personal needs, so ask about the Status you wish to better understand. First, open your Status Window by using the '^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFA^000000' keys.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
我希望我的課程能根據您的個人需求進行，所以請詢問您希望深入瞭解的狀態。首先，請使用'^3355FFAlt^000000 + ^3355FFA^000000'鍵開啟狀態視窗。

scripts.text: Strength and Agility
scripts.translation: 力量和敏捷

scripts.text: Vitality and Intelligence
scripts.translation: 體質和智力

scripts.text: Dexterity and Luck
scripts.translation: 靈巧和幸運

scripts.text: I do not wish to continue.
scripts.translation: 我不想繼續了

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let me explain Strength first.
^4D4DFFStrength (STR)^000000 increases
^4D4DFFphysical attack damage (ATK) ^000000
and your ^4D4DFF maximum weight limit^000000.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
首先讓我來解釋一下力量。
^4D4DFF力量 (STR)^000000會增加^4D4DFF物理攻擊傷害 (ATK)^000000以及你的^4D4DFF最大負重上限^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
1 STR increases your physical attack damage by 1 point. A certain amount of attack damage bonus is given when the STR stat is increased to a multiple of 10.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
1點力量會增加1點物理攻擊傷害。當力量數值達到10的倍數時，會獲得額外的攻擊傷害加成。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The way the attack damage bonus is calculated is by taking the total strength value, removing the very last digit, and squaring the number you have left.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
攻擊傷害加成的計算方法是：取力量總數值，去掉最後一位數字，然後將剩餘的數字平方。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let's say your attack is displayed as '48 + 1.' That's a total of 49 strength. When you remove the last digit, '9,' we are left with the number '4.' 4 multiplied by itself equals 16.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
假設你的攻擊顯示為“48 + 1”，這意味著總力量為49。去掉最後一位數字“9”，剩下數字“4”。4乘以4等於16。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
So the physical attack bonus is 16. Now, if you had a total of 50 STR, the attack bonus would be 25. And if your STR is 100, your attack bonus would be 100.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
所以物理攻擊加成是16。如果你的總力量是50，攻擊加成就是25。如果力量是100，攻擊加成就是100。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Okay, now let's move
on to Agility (AGI).
Agility affects your Flee Rate and Attack Speed. The higher your Flee Rate, the better chance you have of avoiding enemy attacks.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
好的，現在我們來談談敏捷 (AGI)。
敏捷影響你的閃避率和攻擊速度。閃避率越高，你避開敵人攻擊的機會就越大。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Your Flee Rate
is equal to the number
of your Base Level added
to your AGI.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
你的閃避率等於你的基礎等級加上你的敏捷值。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
So if you have 40 AGI and you're at Base Level 30, your Flee Rate would be 70. It's so simple! Following the Flee Rate formula, your flee rate will be a total of 70.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
所以如果你有40點敏捷，基礎等級是30級，你的閃避率就是70。很簡單吧！根據閃避率公式，你的閃避率總計為70。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, AGI only relates to normal Flee Rate. Perfect Dodge is another factor that determines success in dodging attacks, but we'll talk about that when we discuss
the LUK stat.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
現在，敏捷只關係到普通閃避率。完美閃避是決定躲避攻擊成功的另一個因素，但我們討論幸運 (LUK) 屬性時再談這個。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Another benefit to increasing AGI is that your Attack Speed (ASPD) will also increase, meaning the time between your melee attacks will be reduced.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
提高敏捷的另一個好處是你的攻擊速度 (ASPD) 也會增加，這意味著你近戰攻擊之間的間隔會變短。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
ASPD, however,
differs by Job Class,
so please remember that.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
不過，攻擊速度因職業而異，請記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
^666666*Whew!*^000000
That's almost too
much excitement for
one day. Shall we move
on to the next subject?
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
^666666*呼！*^000000
這一天真是太令人興奮了。
我們要繼續下一個主題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Our next subject
will be Vitality (VIT)
and Intelligence (INT).
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
我們的下一個主題是體質 (VIT)和智力 (INT)。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
^4D4DFFVitality^000000 affects the ^4D4DFFmaximum HP, amount of HP restoration and defense^000000. The amount of HP increased by VIT is differs by your job class.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
^4D4DFF體質^000000 影響^4D4DFF最大HP、HP恢復量和防禦力^000000。體質增加的HP量因職業而異。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Out of all the Job Classes, the Swordman class benefits most
from increases in VIT.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
在所有職業中，劍士職業從體質增加中獲益最多。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let's check defense.
On your stat window, your defense is displayed as DEF. Two numerical values are shown, and the second number reflects the addition to your defense by your VIT.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
讓我們來看看防禦力。
在你的狀態視窗中，防禦力顯示為DEF。顯示兩個數值，第二個數值反映了體質對你防禦力的加成。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, the first number
displayed in your Defense is the defense calculated from your Equipment and Armor.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
現在，防禦力顯示的第一個數值是由你的裝備和護甲計算得出的防禦力。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, the equipment you wear reduces damage from enemies by a percentage of the total damage, where VIT reduces by a set amount. That's why Defense is displayed with two numbers.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
你穿戴的裝備按總傷害的百分比減少敵人造成的傷害，而體質則是減少固定數值的傷害。這就是為什麼防禦力顯示兩個數值。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The next subject
is Intelligence (INT).
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
下一個主題是智力 (INT)。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
INT affects your maximum amount of ^4D4DFFSP^000000, ^4D4DFFSP restoration^000000, the ^4D4DFF damage of your magic attack (MATK)^000000 and your ^4D4DFFdefense against magic attack (MDEF)^000000.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
智力影響你的最大^4D4DFFSP^000000、^4D4DFFSP恢復量^000000、^4D4DFF魔法攻擊傷害 (MATK)^000000以及^4D4DFF魔法防禦力 (MDEF)^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The SP amount and MATK increased
by 1 INT is dependent on Job Class, just like VIT. This means that some Jobs will naturally benefit more from having more INT than others.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
每增加1點智力所提升的SP量和MATK值取決於職業，就像體質一樣。這意味著某些職業會比其他職業更受益於高智力。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Just like normal DEF, your Magic Defense (MDEF) shows as 2 different numerical values. The MDEF contributed by INT is the second MDEF value displayed.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
就像普通防禦力一樣，你的魔法防禦力 (MDEF) 也顯示為兩個不同的數值。由智力貢獻的MDEF是顯示的第二個MDEF數值。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
In order to study manipulation of the natural elements, you should prioritize on having intelligence. Therefore, Sages and Wizards
focus on the INT stat.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
為了研究自然元素的操控，你應該優先提升智力。因此，賢者和巫師都專注於提升智力屬性。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Our last subject
is Dexterity (DEX)
and Luck (LUK).
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
我們最後一個主題是靈巧 (DEX) 和幸運 (LUK)。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Dexterity mainly affects your accuracy, attack speed (ASPD)
and your average attack strength.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
靈巧主要影響你的命中率、攻擊速度 (ASPD) 以及你的平均攻擊力。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Let me explain...
If you have low DEX, the difference between the minimum damage and
the maximum damage you can inflict becomes huge. The damage of your attacks becomes unstable.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
讓我解釋一下...
如果你的靈巧較低，你能造成的最小傷害和最大傷害之間的差距就會變得很大。你的攻擊傷害會變得不穩定。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
If you are using a ^4D4DFFBow^000000 as your
main weapon, your attack strength will be based on^4D4DFFDEX^000000. So Archers should focus on increasing their DEX.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
如果你使用^4D4DFF弓^000000作為主武器，你的攻擊力將基於^4D4DFF靈巧^000000。所以弓箭手應該專注於提升靈巧。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
The amount of DEX that you
have will also affect your attack accuracy. Attack accuracy is calculated by the number of your Base Level added to your DEX.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
你擁有的靈巧值也會影響你的攻擊命中率。攻擊命中率是通過你的基礎等級加上靈巧值計算得出的。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
For example, if you are at
Base Level 40 and have 20 DEX,
your attack accuracy would be 60.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
例如，如果你的基礎等級是40，靈巧是20，那麼你的攻擊命中率就是60。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Finally, DEX also reduces the casting time of spells and skills. Therefore, having some DEX would
be handy for Mages and Wizards.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
最後，靈巧還能減少法術和技能的吟唱時間。因此，魔法師和巫師擁有一些靈巧會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Now, let me tell
you about the LUK stat.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
現在，讓我告訴你關於幸運屬性的事。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Luck (LUK) affects the chance
for a critical attack, the Flee Rate and a small amount of damage you deal to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
幸運 (LUK) 影響暴擊機率、閃避率以及你對魔物造成的少量傷害。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
For a critical attack, the start value is 1 for everyone and it's increased by^4d4dff 1^000000 for every ^4d4dff3 LUK^000000.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
對於暴擊攻擊，每個人的起始值是1，並且每^4d4dff3點幸運^000000增加^4d4dff 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
With more LUK, you have an increased change of inflicting ^3355FFcritical attacks^000000 to your enemies. Critical attacks are useful to you, as they pierce your enemy's defense.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
幸運越高，你對敵人造成^3355FF暴擊攻擊^000000的機率就越大。暴擊攻擊對你很有用，因為它們能穿透敵人的防禦。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
You can tell you've performed a critical attack when an attack has inflicted more damage than usual to an enemy, and the damage number is displayed with an explosive red visual effect.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
當一次攻擊對敵人造成的傷害高於平時，且傷害數字以爆炸性的紅色視覺效果顯示時，你就知道發生了暴擊攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
For every 10 LUK, you add 1 point to your Perfect Dodge rate. Perfect Dodge is sort of like your Flee Rate. When you perform a Perfect Dodge, the word '^FF7F00Lucky^000000' will appear over your head.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
每10點幸運，你的完美閃避率增加1點。完美閃避有點像閃避率。當你進行完美閃避時，你的頭頂會出現'^FF7F00Lucky^000000'字樣。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Although similar to your Flee Rate, Perfect Dodge is a separate factor in attack evasion that is calculated differently.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
雖然與閃避率相似，但完美閃避是攻擊迴避中一個獨立的因素，其計算方式不同。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Well, I must say,
Luck is a good thing to have, but that doesn't mean you need it before everything else.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
嗯，我必須說，幸運是一件好事，但這並不意味著你需要把它放在其他一切之前。

scripts.text:
[Jare Riotte]
Do you have any
other questions?
I hope my class
was helpful to you.
scripts.translation:
[亞雷·里奧特]
你還有其他問題嗎？
希望我的課對你有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Welcome~
Oh look at this
cute little Novice~!
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
歡迎~
哦，看看這個可愛的初心者~！

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
I, Leo Handerson,
feel so responsible for your performance and will be teaching you to the best of my ability. Now, please select the subject you wish to learn.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
我，里奧·漢德森，對你的表現深感責任重大，並將盡我所能進行教導。現在，請選擇你想學習的科目。

scripts.text: Passive and Active skills
scripts.translation: 被動與主動技能

scripts.text: Basic Skills
scripts.translation: 基本技能

scripts.text: Use of Emoticons
scripts.translation: 表情符號的使用

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
First, let me explain
about the Passive Skills.
Would please you open
your Skill Window?
('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000')
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
首先，讓我解釋一下被動技能。
請開啟您的技能視窗。
（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000'）

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Now, you know that whenever
your Job Level goes up, you earn
a ^3355FFSkill Point^000000, right? Skill Points are used to learn your skills~
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
現在，你知道每當你的職業等級提升時，都會獲得一個^3355FF技能點^000000，對吧？技能點用於學習你的技能~

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Do you see your Basic Skill icon? It's at the very top of the Skill Window. Click on the 'Lv Up' button next to the Basic Skill icon to use a Skill Point on Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
你看到你的基本技能圖示了嗎？它位於技能視窗的最頂端。點選基本技能圖示旁邊的“Lv Up”按鈕，即可使用技能點提升基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You'll see to the word 'Passive'
to the right of the Basic Skill icon. That means this skill is Passive, and doesn't use any SP.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
你會看到基本技能圖示右側有“被動”字樣。這意味著該技能是被動技能，不消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Now, please right-click the Basic Skill icon. You will then be able to read a brief description of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
現在，請右鍵點選基本技能圖示。然後你就可以閱讀基本技能的簡要描述了。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Active Skills, unlike Passive Skills which don't use any SP, require SP each time that
they are used.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
主動技能與不消耗SP的被動技能不同，每次使用都需要消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can use an Active Skill by double-clicking its icon in your Skill Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
你可以雙擊技能視窗中的圖示來使用主動技能。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can also drag a skill icon from your Skill Window, and drop it into your Hotkey bar ('^3355FFF12^000000' key) to assign a Hotkey to that skill.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
你也可以將技能圖示從技能視窗拖拽到快捷欄（'^3355FFF12^000000'鍵）中，為該技能分配快捷鍵。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
The amount of SP required
to use an Active Skill will be displayed to the right of that skill's icon.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
使用主動技能所需的SP數量將顯示在該技能圖示的右側。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Generally, Passive Skills are skills related to mental or physical training and conditioning. The use of special abilities or attacks are Active Skills.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
通常來說，被動技能是與精神或身體訓練和調理相關的技能。而使用特殊能力或攻擊則屬於主動技能。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
If you're still not
sure about my lesson,
I'm willing to go over
it once again.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
如果你對我的課程仍有任何疑問，我很樂意再講解一遍。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
The Basic Skills are
purely Passive Skills
that you need to play
Ragnarok Online.
Don't worry,
they're easy to learn.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
基本技能是純粹的被動技能，是遊玩《仙境傳說》所必需的。
別擔心，它們很容易學習。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you right-click with your mouse in your Skill Window
('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000'), you can check the descriptions of the skills, but I've prepared this lesson for
your better understanding.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
在技能視窗中右鍵點選（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFS^000000'），你可以檢視技能描述，但我準備了這堂課以便你更好地理解。

scripts.text: Trade and Exchange
scripts.translation: 交易與交換

scripts.text: Organizing & Joining party
scripts.translation: 組建與加入隊伍

scripts.text: Opening Chat Room
scripts.translation: 開啟聊天室

scripts.text: Storage Use
scripts.translation: 使用倉庫

scripts.text: No thanks, I know this already.
scripts.translation: 不用了，我已經知道了

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you go visit our official website at ^0000FFiro.ragnarokonline.com^000000, you can find a full explanation about trading, illustrated with pictures.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
訪問我們的官方網站 ^0000FFiro.ragnarokonline.com^000000，你可以找到關於交易的完整說明，並配有圖片。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
In order to trade items
or zeny with other people,
you must learn at least ^3355FFBasic Skill Level 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
為了與其他玩家交易物品或Zeny，你必須至少學習 ^3355FF基本技能等級 1^000000。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you trade, you must be
located close to the person with which you wish to exchange items or zeny. Otherwise, the trade will not work if that person is more than 2 cells away.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
進行交易時，你必須靠近想要交換物品或Zeny的玩家。否則，如果對方距離超過2格，交易將無法進行。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Right-click on the person
once and a small menu will appear.
From this menu, choose:
^800fffRequest a deal with^000000.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
右鍵點選對方一次，會出現一個小選單。
從選單中選擇：
^800fff請求交易^000000。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Afterwards, that person will
choose whether or not to accept your request. If your trade request is accepted, the Trade Window will appear.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
之後，對方將選擇是否接受你的請求。如果交易請求被接受，交易視窗將會出現。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
To trade items, drag items from your Inventory Window ('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFE^000000') and drop them into the left side of the Trade Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
要交易物品，請將物品從物品欄視窗（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFE^000000'）拖拽並放置在交易視窗的左側。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Items given by the other person will appear in the right side of the Trade Window. Always check
if the other person is trading the items you have agreed to exchange.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
對方給出的物品會出現在交易視窗的右側。請始終檢查對方是否正在交易你們約定交換的物品。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
To trade Zeny, you can enter the amount of Zeny you want to trade. After placing items or Zeny into the Trade Window, press the 'OK' button at the bottom of the Window to confirm the trade.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
要交易Zeny，你可以輸入想要交易的Zeny數量。將物品或Zeny放入交易視窗後，按下視窗底部的“OK”按鈕以確認交易。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Once the trade is confirmed,
press the 'Trade' button to finish the trade. If either of the traders do not press the 'OK' button, the trade cannot be completed.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
交易確認後，按下“交易”按鈕以完成交易。只要有一方沒有按下“OK”按鈕，交易就無法完成。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
If either of the traders presses the 'Cancel' button to the right of the window, the trade will be cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
如果任何一方按下視窗右側的“取消”按鈕，交易將被取消。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Now, let me explain
about the Party System.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
現在，讓我來解釋一下隊伍系統。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
The Party system allows
you to organize a small group with people in order to cooperatively hunt monsters, or just to have fun together.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
隊伍系統允許你組織一個小團體，以便合作狩獵魔物，或者只是在一起玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can organize
a party by typing
the command:
^4F4FFF//organize ''Party Name''^000000
in your Chat Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
你可以在聊天視窗中輸入以下命令來組建隊伍：
^4F4FFF//organize ''隊伍名稱''^000000

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Of course, you
must be at least
^4d4dffBasic Skill Level 7^000000
or above to use the Party System.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
當然，你必須至少達到^4d4dff基本技能等級 7^000000才能使用隊伍系統。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
I could explain more about
the distribution of items or the distribution of experience which party members have gained together, but it's that you try that out on your own later on.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
我可以進一步解釋物品分配或隊伍成員共同獲得的經驗值分配，但建議你之後自己嘗試一下。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
That's all for
the Party System~
An adorable Novice
like you should pick
on this really quickly~
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
關於隊伍系統就講到這裡~
像你這樣可愛的初心者應該能很快掌握~

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you have
^4D4DFFLevel 4 Basic Skill^000000
or above, you can open your own Chat Room. You can either click
the ^3355FFchat^000000 button in the Basic Info Window or just press '^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFC^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
當你擁有^4D4DFF等級 4 基本技能^000000或更高時，你可以開啟自己的聊天室。你可以點選基本資訊視窗中的 ^3355FF聊天^000000 按鈕，或者直接按下 '^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFC^000000'。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Once you open a Chat Room,
you can check the chat room members' information by right-clicking on a character name.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
開啟聊天室後，你可以右鍵點選角色名稱來檢視聊天室成員的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Also you can register that character as your friend in the same way. If you are the master
of the room, you can change
the room setup.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
同樣，你也可以用同樣的方式將該角色新增為好友。如果你是房間的主人，還可以更改房間設定。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
While in the Chat Room,
you cannot hear any chat from outside of the Chat Room. Please remember that, okay?
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
在聊天室中，你無法聽到聊天室外部的對話。請牢記這一點，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Kafra Employees of the
Kafra Corporation are scattered throughout the world, providing their convenient services and Storage.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
卡普拉公司的卡普拉 職員遍佈世界各地，為您提供便捷的服務和倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
In fact, there's a Kafra Employee just outside of this room. Talk to her, and she'll be more than happy to fully explain Kafra's Services.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
事實上，就在這個房間外面就有一位卡普拉 職員。和她對話，她會非常樂意為您詳細介紹卡普拉的服務。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Anyway, you are
allowed to use your
^4d4dffpersonal Kafra Storage^000000
at ^4D4DFFBasic Skill Level 6^000000 or above.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
總之，當您的^4d4dff基本技能等級達到 6^000000或更高時，就可以使用您的^4d4dff個人卡普拉倉庫^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
When you carry too many items with you, your weight becomes too heavy and you won't be able to restore HP or SP by resting, or even fight monsters! So store what you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
如果您攜帶的物品過多，負重會變得太重，導致您無法通過休息恢復HP或SP，甚至無法戰鬥！所以請將不需要的物品存入卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Oh, do you?
As I expected,
you're as smart
as you are cute~!
I, Leo, am very impressed.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
哦，是嗎？
正如我所料，你既聰明又可愛~！
我，里奧，對此印象深刻。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Do you wish to
learn more about
a different subject?
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
您想學習關於其他主題的更多知識嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
^4d4dffEmoticons^000000 are commonly used
online for ^4D4DFFdisplaying your feelings^000000. It's a fun way of communicating!
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
^4d4dff表情符號^000000通常用於線上^4D4DFF表達您的情感^000000。這是一種有趣的交流方式！

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You must first be at
^4D4DFFBasic Skill Level 2^000000
or above to use emoticons.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
您必須首先達到^4D4DFF基本技能等級 2^000000或更高才能使用表情符號。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can check the
Emotion icon List
('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFL^000000') and click each icon to see the command to display
the emoticon.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
您可以查看錶情圖示列表（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFL^000000'），點選每個圖示即可檢視顯示該表情符號的命令。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can also register
emoticons into your Shortcut List ('^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFM^000000') so you can just use a Shortcut to use an emoticon. This is also fully explained on our official website as well.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
您還可以將表情符號註冊到快捷列表（'^3355FFAlt^000000' + '^3355FFM^000000'）中，這樣只需使用快捷鍵即可傳送表情符號。我們的官方網站上也有詳細說明。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Ah~ I must say,
the honest expression
of one's feelings is essential
for a relationship.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
啊~ 我必須說，真誠地表達自己的情感對於建立關係至關重要。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
You can play
Rock, Paper, Scissors
by pressing the '^4D4DFFCtrl^000000' and the '^4D4DFF - ^000000,' '^4D4DFF = ^000000,' or '^4D4DFF \ ^000000' keys.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
您可以按下'^4D4DFFCtrl^000000'鍵和'^4D4DFF - ^000000'、'^4D4DFF = ^000000'或'^4D4DFF \ ^000000'鍵來玩石頭剪刀布。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
Of course, you can type ^4D4DFF//bawi^000000, ^4D4DFF//bo^000000 and ^4D4DFF//gawi^000000, which mean rock, paper, scissors in Korean, into your Chat Window.
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
當然，您也可以輸入^4D4DFF//bawi^000000、^4D4DFF//bo^000000和^4D4DFF//gawi^000000，它們分別代表韓語中的石頭、剪刀和布，到聊天視窗中。

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
To check out the commands for even more emoticons, type the command ^4d4dff//emotion^000000 into your Chat Window to see the list~
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
要檢視更多表情符號的命令，請在聊天視窗中輸入命令^4d4dff//emotion^000000以檢視列表~

scripts.text:
[Leo Handerson]
I see...
You don't need me
anymore! Oh! They
grow up so fast
nowadays!
scripts.translation:
[里奧·漢德森]
我明白了...
你不需要我了！
哦！現在的孩子長得真快啊！

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
We Guide Soldiers provide location information at the entrance of every town. You can easily find us by our special uniforms.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導士兵]
我們嚮導士兵在每個城鎮的入口處提供位置資訊。您可以通過我們特殊的制服輕鬆找到我們。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
Whenever you visit a town
for the first time, we would like to recommend that you check the locations of notable places in town with us.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導士兵]
每次您第一次訪問一個城鎮時，我們建議您與我們一起檢視城鎮中重要地點的位置。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
If you wish to take an Informative class, please walk around and speak to the various tutors in these Training Grounds. Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導士兵]
如果您想上資訊課，請四處走動並與這些訓練場中的各種導師對話。祝您愉快。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Congratulations!
You have passed the 1st training course! Wow~ I guess now you understand a little bit more about Ragnarok Online.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
恭喜！
你通過了第一階段的訓練課程！哇~ 我想你現在對《仙境傳說》有了一些更深的瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
You will learn the fundamentals of actual battle through this class. If you did your best through the Informative class, you are supposed to have been given some starting equipment.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
在這節課中，你將學習實戰的基礎知識。如果你在資訊課上表現良好，應該已經獲得了一些初始裝備。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Please check your
equipment before you engaging in battle. Are you sure you've equipped all of your equipment, your weapons and armor?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
在投入戰鬥之前，請檢查你的裝備。你確定已經裝備了所有的物品、武器和防具嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
First, you place the cursor on a monster. When you left click, you will hit the monster once.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
首先，將游標放在魔物身上。當你點選滑鼠左鍵時，你會攻擊魔物一次。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you are too lazy to keep left clicking, left click on the monster while holding the '^4D4DFFCtrl^000000' key. You will then continue attacking the monster until one of you is dead, or you run away.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果你懶得一直按滑鼠左鍵，可以在按住'^4D4DFFCtrl^000000'鍵的同時點選魔物。這樣你會持續攻擊魔物，直到其中一方死亡，或者你逃跑為止。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
You can also just hold down the left mouse button while the cursor is on the monster. Still, there are some people who are even too lazy to use the '^4D4DFFCtrl^000000' key every time they attack a monster.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
你也可以在游標位於魔物身上時，按住滑鼠左鍵不放。不過，有些人甚至懶得每次攻擊魔物都使用'^4D4DFFCtrl^000000'鍵。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you're one of them, type the command ^E79E29//nc^000000 in your Chat Window. Then, when you left click
a monster, you'll just continuously attack it!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果你也是其中之一，請在聊天視窗中輸入命令^E79E29//nc^000000。這樣，當你點選魔物時，你就會持續攻擊它！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If a monster happens to have the Undead property, you can use the 'Heal' skill to attack if you happen to have it.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果魔物恰好擁有不死屬性，而你又擁有'治癒術'技能，你可以使用它來攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you use the Heal skill while holding down the '^4D4DFFShift^000000' key, you can target the monster with the Heal skill to damage it.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
當你在按住'^4D4DFFShift^000000'鍵時使用治癒術，你可以將目標鎖定在魔物身上以對其造成傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Of course for this skill, we do have a very convenient option for lazy people too. Type the command ^E79E29//ns^000000 in your Chat Window.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
當然，對於這項技能，我們也為懶人準備了一個非常方便的功能。請在聊天視窗中輸入命令^E79E29//ns^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
This will allow you to attack monsters by using the Heal skill without holding the shift key. Handy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
這將允許你使用治癒術攻擊魔物，而無需按住Shift鍵。很方便吧？

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Do you understand these battle commands? Now, I will teaching you about monster behaviors and properties, experience gained through battle, and items you can earn from dead monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
你理解這些戰鬥指令了嗎？現在，我將教你關於魔物的行為和屬性、通過戰鬥獲得的經驗值，以及從死亡的魔物身上可以獲得的物品。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Field Combat Training can be actually be pretty dangerous for new adventurers. Let me give you
a little more strength through the power of my magic.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
野外戰鬥訓練對新手冒險者來說可能相當危險。讓我用我的魔力為你增加一點力量。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Haaaaaaa~!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
哈啊啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Which subject
should I cover
first for you?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
你想先了解哪個主題？

scripts.text: Monsters
scripts.translation: 魔物

scripts.text: Experience
scripts.translation: 經驗值

scripts.text: Items
scripts.translation: 物品

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are many aggressive monsters that will attack you first before you even approach them.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
有許多具有攻擊性的魔物，它們會在你靠近之前先攻擊你。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are also a few monsters that will cooperate with others of their kind. Attack one of them, and the whole pack of them will swarm around you, seeking revenge.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
也有一些魔物會與同類合作。攻擊其中一個，它們整個群體就會圍上來，尋求復仇。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Every monster can be specified by their types, sizes and properties. For example, there are Demi-human, Brute, Holy and Demon property monsters out there.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
每種魔物都可以通過其種族、體型和屬性來區分。例如，有人形、動物、天使和惡魔等種族的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you're aware of what property a monster is, you can use that knowledge to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
當你瞭解魔物的屬性後，就可以利用這些知識來輔助戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you manage to get cards for that increase your damage upon certain monster properties, or reduce damage from specific monster properties, you'll have a much easier time in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果你能獲取增加對特定屬性魔物傷害，或減少來自特定屬性魔物傷害的卡片，戰鬥將會輕鬆許多。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Monsters are separated by their size: small, medium and large. There are a few cards that allow you to do more damage to
a specific monster size.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
魔物按大小分為小型、中型和大型。有一些卡片可以讓你對特定大小的魔物造成更多傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Also, each weapon has its strengths and weaknesses. The size of the weapon will affect the damage it will deal to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
此外，每種武器都有其強項和弱項。武器的大小會影響它對魔物造成的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For example, Dagger class weapons do 100 % damage on small sized monsters but only inflict 50 % on large monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
例如，短劍類武器對小型魔物造成100%的傷害，但對大型魔物只造成50%的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Common monster properties include Water, Wind, Earth, Fire, Shadow, Ghost and Holy. If you attack a monster with an opposing property, you can inflict additional damage~
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
常見的魔物屬性包括水、風、地、火、暗、幽靈和神聖。如果你用相剋屬性的攻擊去攻擊魔物，可以造成額外傷害~

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
But if you attack a monster with
a skill or weapon that inflicts damage of the same property as the monster, the damage will be greatly reduced, or completely negated. You might even heal the monster!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
但是，如果你用與魔物屬性相同的技能或武器攻擊它，傷害會大幅降低，甚至完全無效。你甚至可能會治療魔物！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
In the case of Ghost property monsters, normal weapons cannot do any harm. However, a weapon with any other property will be able to deal out some damage.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
對於幽靈屬性的魔物，普通武器無法造成傷害。然而，具有其他屬性的武器可以對其造成一定傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Basically, a character who deals the most damage on a monster receives the most experience points from the monster.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
基本上，對魔物造成傷害最多的角色，會從該魔物身上獲得最多的經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Therefore, you receive a certain percentage of experience points in proportion to the damage you've inflicted on the monster, compared to its total HP.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
因此，你獲得的經驗值比例，取決於你對魔物造成的傷害與其總HP的比例。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Let's say, there is a character named 'Z.' Z does 65 damage on a monster that has 100 total HP and gives 1000 experience points when it's dead. So, Z will receive 650 experience points.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
假設有一個叫'Z'的角色。Z對一隻總HP為100、死亡時提供1000經驗值的魔物造成了65點傷害。那麼，Z將獲得650點經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
However, this rule applies differently following certain situations.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
不過，在某些情況下，這條規則會有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If there are two people who both did 65 damage on the same monster, the experience points that each will receive differs, depending on the monster's remaining HP.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果有兩個人都對同一只魔物造成了65點傷害，他們各自獲得的經驗值會根據魔物剩餘的HP而有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For instance, somebody does damage to a monster while you're already hitting it, and he did the same amount of damage you did.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
例如，當你正在攻擊一隻魔物時，另一個人也對其造成了傷害，且傷害量與你相同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
In this case, you will receive 2//3 of the whole experience points that monster can give you, the other one will receive 1//3.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
在這種情況下，你將獲得該魔物總經驗值的2/3，而另一個人將獲得1/3。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
However, attacking a monster that somebody already started to hit is not suggested in Ragnarok Online. That action is regarded as ill-mannered behavior.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
然而，在《仙境傳說》中，不建議攻擊別人已經開始攻擊的魔物。這種行為被視為不禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For party play, the party master can set the experience distribution to the equally share option.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
在隊伍遊戲中，隊長可以將經驗分配設定為“平均分配”選項。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
With this method, party members can share their experience according to the their character levels, and the number of members in the party.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
通過這種方式，隊伍成員可以根據他們的角色等級和隊伍中的人數來分享經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Also, there is the experience benefit for party play which allows you to gain more experience points than playing solo. You can take advantage of this system for faster leveling.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
此外，隊伍遊戲還有經驗加成，允許你獲得比單人遊戲更多的經驗值。你可以利用這個系統來更快升級。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you kill monsters,
you can obtain items by chance. Furthermore, certain characters can use the 'Steal' skill in order to steal items from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
當你擊殺魔物時，有機會獲得物品。此外，某些角色可以使用<偷竊>技能從魔物身上偷取物品。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Don't you worry about the Steal skill causing you to not find any items after you kill them. Using the Steal skill does not at all affect the item drop rate for monsters once they're killed.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
不用擔心使用<偷竊>技能會導致擊殺魔物後無法掉落物品。使用<偷竊>技能完全不會影響魔物被擊殺後的物品掉落率。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When a group of people kill a monster, the person who did the most damage receives priority in picking up item drops.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
當一群人共同擊殺一隻魔物時，造成最高傷害的人擁有拾取掉落物品的優先權。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Feel free to
ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果您有任何問題，請隨時向我提問。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Please take care of the equipment you've received through the training courses. Once you lose the equipment, you can never get them back.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
請妥善保管您在訓練課程中獲得的裝備。一旦丟失，將無法再次獲得。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Which subject
shall I expain?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
您想了解哪方面的內容？

scripts.text: Monsters
scripts.translation: 魔物

scripts.text: Experience
scripts.translation: 經驗值

scripts.text: Items
scripts.translation: 物品

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are many aggressive monsters that will attack you first before you even approach them.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
有許多具有攻擊性的魔物，它們會在你靠近之前先攻擊你。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
There are also a few monsters that will cooperate with others of their kind. Attack one of them, and the whole pack of them will swarm around you, seeking revenge.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
也有一些魔物會與同類合作。攻擊其中一個，它們整個群體就會圍上來，尋求復仇。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Every monster can be specified by their types, sizes and properties. For example, there are Demi-human, Brute, Holy and Demon property monsters out there.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
每種魔物都可以通過其種族、體型和屬性來區分。例如，有人形、動物、天使和惡魔等種族的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
When you're aware of what property a monster is, you can use that knowledge to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
當你瞭解魔物的屬性後，就可以利用這些知識來輔助戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If you manage to get cards for that increase your damage upon certain monster properties, or reduce damage from specific monster properties, you'll have a much easier time in battle.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果你能獲取增加對特定屬性魔物傷害，或減少來自特定屬性魔物傷害的卡片，戰鬥將會輕鬆許多。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Monsters are separated by their size: small, medium and large. There are a few cards that allow you to do more damage to a specific monster size.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
魔物按體型分為小型、中型和大型。有一些卡片可以增加您對特定體型魔物的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Also, each weapon has its strengths and weaknesses. The size of the weapon will affect the damage it will deal to monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
此外，每種武器都有其強項和弱項。武器的大小會影響它對魔物造成的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
For example, Dagger class weapons do 100 % damage on small sized monsters but only inflict 50 % on large monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
例如，短劍類武器對小型魔物造成100%的傷害，但對大型魔物只造成50%的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Common monster properties include Water, Wind, Earth, Fire, Shadow, Ghost and Holy. If you attack a monster with an opposing property, you can inflict additional damage~
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
常見的魔物屬性包括水、風、地、火、暗、幽靈和神聖。如果你用相剋屬性的攻擊去攻擊魔物，可以造成額外傷害~

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
But if you attack a monster with
a skill or weapon that inflicts damage of the same property as the monster, the damage will be greatly reduced, or completely negated. You might even heal the monster!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
但是，如果你用與魔物屬性相同的技能或武器攻擊它，傷害會大幅降低，甚至完全無效。你甚至可能會治療魔物！

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
In the case of Ghost property monsters, normal weapons cannot do any harm. However, a weapon with any other property will be able to deal out some damage.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
對於幽靈屬性的魔物，普通武器無法造成傷害。然而，具有其他屬性的武器可以對其造成一定傷害。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Basically, a character who deals the most damage on a monster receives the most experience points from the monster.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
基本上，對魔物造成傷害最多的角色，會從該魔物身上獲得最多的經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Therefore, you receive a certain percentage of experience points in proportion to the damage you've inflicted on the monster, compared to its total HP.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
因此，你獲得的經驗值比例，取決於你對魔物造成的傷害與其總HP的比例。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Let's say, there is a character named 'Z.' Z does 65 damage on a monster that has 100 total HP and gives 1000 experience points when it's dead. So, Z will receive 650 experience points.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
假設有一個叫'Z'的角色。Z對一隻總HP為100、死亡時提供1000經驗值的魔物造成了65點傷害。那麼，Z將獲得650點經驗值。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
However, this rule applies differently following certain situations.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
不過，在某些情況下，這條規則會有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
If there are two people who both did 65 damage on the same monster, the experience points that each will receive differs, depending on the monster's remaining HP.
scripts.translation:

如果有兩個人都對同一只魔物造成了65點傷害，他們各自獲得的經驗值會根據魔物剩餘的HP而有所不同。

scripts.text:

In this case, you will receive 2//3 of the whole experience points that monster can give you, the other one will receive 1//3.
scripts.translation:

在這種情況下，你將獲得該魔物總經驗值的2/3，而另一個人將獲得1/3。

[Elmeen]
However, attacking a monster that somebody already started to hit is not suggested in Ragnarok Online. That action is regarded as ill-mannered behavior.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
然而，在《仙境傳說》中，不建議攻擊別人已經開始攻擊的魔物。這種行為被視為不禮貌。

scripts.text:

For party play, the party master can set the experience distribution to the equally share option.
scripts.translation:

在隊伍遊戲中，隊長可以將經驗分配設定為“平均分配”選項。

With this method, party members can share their experience according to the their character levels, and the number of members in the party.
scripts.translation:

通過這種方式，隊伍成員可以根據他們的角色等級和隊伍中的人數來分享經驗值。

scripts.text:

Also, there is the experience benefit for party play which allows you to gain more experience points than playing solo. You can take advantage of this system for faster leveling.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
此外，隊伍遊戲還有經驗加成，允許你獲得比單人遊戲更多的經驗值。你可以利用這個系統來更快升級。

When you kill monsters,
you can obtain items by chance. Furthermore, certain characters can use the 'Steal' skill in order to steal items from monsters.
scripts.translation:

當你擊殺魔物時，有機會獲得物品。此外，某些角色可以使用<偷竊>技能從魔物身上偷取物品。

Don't you worry about the Steal skill causing you to not find any items after you kill them. Using the Steal skill does not at all affect the item drop rate for monsters once they're killed.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
不用擔心使用<偷竊>技能會導致擊殺魔物後無法掉落物品。使用<偷竊>技能完全不會影響魔物被擊殺後的物品掉落率。

[Elmeen]
When a group of people kill a monster, the person who did the most damage receives priority in picking up item drops.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
當一群人共同擊殺一隻魔物時，造成最高傷害的人擁有拾取掉落物品的優先權。

scripts.text:
[Elmeen]
Feel free to
ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾敏]
如果您有任何問題，請隨時向我提問。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I'm sorry, but I can't let anybody who hasn't been instructed on fighting enter the Field Combat Training Grounds.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
很抱歉，我不能讓沒有接受過戰鬥指導的人進入野外戰鬥訓練場。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Why don't you speak to the Helper to the left side of this room first, so that you can receive some battle instruction?
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
您不妨先和這個房間左邊的助手對話，接受一些戰鬥指導？

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Field Combat Training is an actual fight class where you can gain basic fighting skills that you can use to defend yourself in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
野外戰鬥訓練是一堂實戰課，您可以獲得用於在米德加爾特自衛的基礎戰鬥技能。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Please kill as many monsters as you can to increase your base level at least 2 times.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
請儘可能多地擊殺魔物，將您的基礎等級至少提升2級。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Gaining 2 base levels is required to complete your Field Combat Training. Although the monsters are all weak and easy to kill, I hope you will be careful.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
提升2級基礎等級是完成野外戰鬥訓練的必要條件。雖然這些魔物都很弱且容易擊殺，但我希望您能小心行事。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Do you wish
to take the test
right away?
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
您希望立即進行測試嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: I need more time.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多時間

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Please make sure you
talk to the staff at the North after you increase your base level by 2 levels through battle.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
請確保在通過戰鬥將基礎等級提升2級後，與北邊的職員對話。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I'm going to give you some useful supplies, so please use them in case of an emergency.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
我會給您一些有用的補給品，請在緊急情況下使用它們。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
No problem.
If you're not sure if you can pass the test or not, why don't you go talk to the Helper to the left one more time? Please come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
沒問題。
如果您不確定自己能否通過測試，不妨再去和左邊的助手對話一次？
請準備好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Oh well, I told you to be careful. Cheer up! It's not a big deal.
 
Failure teaches success.
You have many chances
to re-take the test.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
好吧，我早就告訴過你要小心了。振作起來！這沒什麼大不了的。

失敗是成功之母。
您有很多機會重新測試。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Do you wish
to try again?
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
您希望再試一次嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Can I have more time?
scripts.translation: 我可以多要一些時間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I will give you
some supplies again.
Please be careful!
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
我會再給您一些補給品。
請小心！

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
No problem.
If you're not sure if you can pass the test or not, why don't you go talk to the Helper to the left one more time? Please come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
沒問題。
如果您不確定自己能否通過測試，不妨再去和左邊的助手對話一次？
請準備好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Oh well, I told you to be careful. Cheer up! It's not a big deal.
 
Failure teaches success.
You have many chances to re-take the test.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
唉，我早就讓你小心了。振作點！沒什麼大不了的。

失敗是成功之母。
你還有很多機會重新參加測試。

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
Do you wish to try again?
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
您希望再試一次嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Can I have more time?
scripts.translation: 我可以多要一些時間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
I will restore
your HP. Please
be careful!
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
我會恢復您的HP。
請小心！

scripts.text:
[Muriel]
No problem.
If you're not sure if you can pass the test or not, why don't you go talk to the Helper to the left one more time? Please come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[穆里爾]
沒問題。
如果您不確定自己能否通過測試，不妨再去和左邊的助手對話一次？
請準備好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
Hey there~
I'm here to provide
you with a little instruction.
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
嘿~
我來給你一點指導。

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
These monsters are all weak
and easy to kill. But be careful,
a lot of them are aggressive
and out for blood!
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
這些魔物都很弱，很容易就能打敗。但小心點，它們大多具有攻擊性，而且很兇猛！

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
If you think monsters here are too weak for you, I can send you to another training ground where the monsters are stronger than the ones over here.
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
如果你覺得這裡的魔物太弱了，我可以把你送到另一個訓練場，那裡的魔物比這裡的更強。

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
But don't worry so much,
They're not impossible for
Novices. So would you
like to try?
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
不過別太擔心，它們對初心者來說並不是不可能戰勝的。
那麼，你想試試嗎？

scripts.text: I do want more of a challenge~
scripts.translation: 我想接受更大的挑戰~

scripts.text: I wanna fight tough monsters!
scripts.translation: 我想打更強的魔物！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
I see, then let me guide
you to a training ground that has stronger monsters. May God be with you...
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
明白了，那麼讓我帶你去一個魔物更強的訓練場吧。願上帝保佑你...

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
You must like 
rough challenges,
don't you? Please
be careful, it can get
pretty difficult...
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
看來你喜歡激烈的挑戰，對吧？請小心，那裡可能會非常困難...

scripts.text:
[Hoffman]
Hmm...?
Are you worried about going
to more challenging places? That's understandable, since you're still a new adventurer. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[霍夫曼]
嗯...？
你擔心去更具挑戰性的地方嗎？這很正常，畢竟你還是個新冒險者。祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Keyman]
Good!!
Now you know how to fight
against monsters, don't you?
Would you like to move
to the next course?
scripts.translation:
[鑰匙人]
很好！！
現在你知道如何與魔物戰鬥了，對吧？
你想進入下一門課程嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Keyman]
I hope you will be
a good fighter in the
future. Bon voyage.
scripts.translation:
[鑰匙人]
希望你將來成為一名優秀的戰士。
一路順風。

scripts.text:
[Keyman]
I see...
It can't hurt to practice until you're more comfortable with the basics of battle.
scripts.translation:
[鑰匙人]
我明白了...
在熟練掌握戰鬥基礎之前，多練習一下也無妨。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
All of the items you are carrying must be quite a burden. Where did you get so much things? Please lighten your weight by getting rid of things you don't need.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你攜帶的所有物品肯定是個不小的負擔。你在哪裡弄到這麼多東西的？請丟棄不需要的物品來減輕負重。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Good day,
^A62A2A{0}'^000000.
You've made quite
an effort to come here.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
你好，^A62A2A{0}^000000。
你來到這裡一定很不容易。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
This final test in the Training Grounds is a personality test,
but it's not a mandatory course.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
訓練場的最後一項測試是性格測試，但這不是必修課程。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
However, there are some benefits
to taking this test. When you take this test, you'll receive many health items which will help you when you join the Ragnarok Online community.
scripts.translation:
[漢森]
不過，參加這項測試有一些好處。當你參加這項測試時，你會收到許多恢復物品，這將在你加入仙境傳說社群時派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Hanson]
Secondly, after you finish the course we will suggest the job class that seems best suited to your personality and teleport you to a town where you can change into the job we suggested.

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
As the name implies, the
Swordman is an expert in wielding Swords. They can also use Spear weapons, but typically you don't see Spear wielding Swordmen very often.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
顧名思義，劍士是擅長使用劍的專家。他們也可以使用長矛，但通常很少見到使用長矛的劍士。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Swordman possess strong physical strength, allowing them to equip heavy armor and weapons. Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods, can be equipped by the Swordman class.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
劍士擁有強大的體力，可以裝備重型護甲和武器。除了弓和法杖外，劍士可以裝備大多數型別的武器。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells. However, this can be compensated by using weapons with an elemental attribute.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
劍士唯一的弱點是無法使用魔法。不過，這可以通過使用帶有屬性攻擊的武器來彌補。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
One of the greatest benefits of being a Swordman is having an enormous amount of HP, meaning they can more easily withstand damage from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
成為劍士最大的優點之一是擁有大量的HP，這意味著他們能更輕鬆地承受敵人的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
After learning some strong attack skills, the Swordman is almost unbeatable in a melee fight.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
在學習了一些強力攻擊技能後，劍士在近戰中幾乎無人能敵。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Swordman generally takes the position of tanker, protecting characters of other classes from being attacked or hurt.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
在《仙境傳說》中，劍士通常擔任坦克的角色，保護其他職業的角色免受攻擊或傷害。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
A Swordman is the ideal character to take the position of party leader. When advancing to the Second Job Class, Swordmen can change their jobs to ^8E2323Knights^000000 or ^8E2323Crusaders^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
劍士是擔任隊伍首領的理想人選。在轉職為二轉職業時，劍士可以轉職為^8E2323騎士^000000或^8E2323十字軍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Mage class specializes in using the forces of Fire, Water, Earth and Lightning to attack their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
魔法師職業擅長利用火、水、土和雷的力量攻擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
However, due to their weak physical strength, they are only allowed to equip Rods and Knives as weapons, and wear light armor for defense.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
然而，由於體力較弱，他們只能裝備法杖和匕首作為武器，並穿著輕型護甲進行防禦。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite their physical weakness, they are able to do massive damage with their powerful spells. This fact alone attracts many people to join this class.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
儘管體力較弱，但他們能憑藉強大的法術造成鉅額傷害。僅憑這一點就吸引了許多人選擇這個職業。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, the Mage takes a heavily offensive role in parties and is depended upon to deal great damage to enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
在《仙境傳說》中，魔法師在隊伍中擔任主要的輸出角色，負責對敵人造成大量傷害。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Archer class are experts in using Bow weapons, and are useful in parties for their long range attacks.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
弓箭手職業是擅長使用弓的專家，在隊伍中因其遠端攻擊能力而非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite being physically weaker, Archers possess high accuracy with powerful long range bows. This allows them to attack and kill monsters from a safe distance.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
儘管體力較弱，但弓箭手擁有極高的命中率和強大的遠端弓。這使他們能夠在安全的距離外攻擊並擊殺魔物。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Archers have relatively little HP, but their long range attacks allow them to easily dispatch enemies before the enemy gets close enough to hurt them.

My duty is to assist you by teaching information about each First Job Class, so that you can decide which job you want to be.
scripts.translation:

^0000FFSwordman, Mage, Archer, Merchant, Thief and Acolyte^000000.

you have in mind?

你想選擇哪個職業？

scripts.text: Mage

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
As the name implies, the
Swordman is an expert in wielding Swords. They can also use Spear weapons, but typically you don't see Spear wielding Swordmen
very often.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
顧名思義，劍士是擅長使用劍的專家。他們也可以使用長矛類武器，但通常很少見到使用長矛的劍士。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Swordmen possess strong physical strength, allowing them to equip heavy armor and weapons. Most weapon classes, except for bows and rods, can be equipped by the Swordman class.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
劍士擁有強大的體力，可以裝備重型護甲和武器。除了弓和法杖外，劍士可以裝備大多數武器型別。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The only weakness of the Swordman class is that they cannot use magic spells. However, this can be compensated by using weapons with an elemental attribute.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
劍士唯一的弱點是無法使用魔法。不過，這可以通過使用帶有屬性攻擊的武器來彌補。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
One of the greatest benefits of being a Swordman is having an enormous amount of HP, meaning they can more easily withstand damage from their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
成為劍士最大的優點之一是擁有大量的HP，這意味著他們能更輕鬆地承受敵人的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
After learning some strong attack skills, the Swordman is almost unbeatable in a melee fight.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
在學習了一些強力攻擊技能後，劍士在近戰中幾乎無人能敵。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, Swordman generally takes the position of tanker, protecting characters of other classes from being attacked or hurt.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
在《仙境傳說》中，劍士通常擔任坦克的角色，保護其他職業的角色免受攻擊或傷害。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
A Swordman is the ideal character to take the position of party leader. When advancing to the Second Job Class, Swordmen can change their jobs to ^8E2323Knights^000000 or ^8E2323Crusaders^000000.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
劍士是擔任隊伍首領的理想人選。在轉職為二轉職業時，劍士可以轉職為^8E2323騎士^000000或^8E2323十字軍^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Mage class specializes in using the forces of Fire, Water, Earth and Lightning to attack their enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
魔法師職業擅長利用火、水、土和雷的力量攻擊敵人。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
However, due to their weak physical strength, they are only allowed to equip Rods and Knives as weapons, and wear light armor for defense.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
然而，由於體力較弱，他們只能裝備法杖和匕首作為武器，並穿著輕型護甲進行防禦。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite their physical weakness, they are able to do massive damage with their powerful spells. This fact alone attracts many people to join this class.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
儘管體力較弱，但他們能憑藉強大的法術造成鉅額傷害。僅憑這一點就吸引了許多人選擇這個職業。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
In Ragnarok Online, the Mage takes a heavily offensive role in parties and is depended upon to deal great damage to enemies.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
在《仙境傳說》中，魔法師在隊伍中擔任主要的輸出角色，負責對敵人造成大量傷害。

[Bruce]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
The Archer class are experts in using Bow weapons, and are useful in parties for their long range attacks.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
弓箭手職業是擅長使用弓的專家，在隊伍中因其遠端攻擊能力而非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Bruce]
Despite being physically weaker, Archers possess high accuracy with powerful long range bows. This allows them to attack and kill monsters from a safe distance.
scripts.translation:
[布魯斯]
儘管體力較弱，但弓箭手擁有極高的命中率和強大的遠端弓。這使他們能夠在安全的距離外攻擊並擊殺魔物。

scripts.text:
